نتلاوم (form VI)
# نَتَلَاوَمُ (natalāwamu) /na.ta.laː.wa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# نَتَلَاوَمَ (natalāwama) /na.ta.laː.wa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# نَتَلَاوَمْ (natalāwam) /na.ta.laː.wam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
